findings.description: While your current code is safe, a common mistake is to use user-supplied input as the format string in printf, which can lead to a format string vulnerability (CWE-134: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String).
Your code does not use any unsafe functions like gets, strcpy, or scanf with %s without a width specifier, so there is no buffer overflow risk here.
